ruleDefinitions.name: Use of Scriptrunner.exe
ruleDefinitions.description: The "ScriptRunner.exe" binary can be abused to proxy execution through it and bypass possible whitelisting

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\ScriptRunner\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "ScriptRunner\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-appvscript\\ .*"))
